description: This file defines the ContactDetailFragment class, responsible for displaying detailed information about a specific contact, including photo, name, and addresses, within an Android contacts application. It manages contact data loading via Loaders, handles UI updates, and supports interactions such as viewing addresses and editing contacts.

classes.name: ContactDetailFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays detailed contact information, handles data loading from the Contacts ContentProvider, manages UI components for contact details, and provides options for editing contact data.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of ContactDetailFragment with a specific contact Uri.

methods.name: setContact
methods.description: Sets the contact Uri for the fragment, updates UI elements and initiates data loading.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes fragment state, including screen layout type and image loader setup.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout, initializes view references.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Restores or initializes contact data after activity creation.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current contact Uri state for configuration changes.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions, notably editing the contact.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates fragment-specific menu options and manages visibility of menu items.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates CursorLoader instances for contact details and addresses based on loader ID.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Handles data once loading completes, updating UI with contact name and addresses.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Handles loader reset events (no specific action needed).

methods.name: buildEmptyAddressLayout
methods.description: Creates a layout indicating no addresses found.

methods.name: buildAddressLayout
methods.description: Builds a layout for a contact address, including view button to show location.

methods.name: constructGeoUri
methods.description: Creates a geo: URI from a postal address for mapping intents.

methods.name: getLargestScreenDimension
methods.description: Returns the maximum of screen width or height in pixels for image sizing.

methods.name: loadContactPhoto
methods.description: Loads and decodes a contact photo thumbnail as a Bitmap, handling different Android API levels.
